# CANDIDATE: LATE_DAY_RIBBON_FADE_VWAP_DEVIATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

In the last hour (14:30-15:50 EST), a flattening EMA ribbon (|EMA8-EMA21| < 0.0005*price) combined with significant VWAP deviation (|price-VWAP| > 0.2*ATR(14)) precedes a mean-reversion to VWAP. This edge exists because ribbon flattening indicates fading momentum while VWAP deviation marks an overextended move likely to revert intraday, particularly in elevated volatility regimes (VIX>16) after avoiding early-session noise and FOMC disruption.

## Mechanism

Entry: At bar close when time >= 14:30 EST AND |EMA8-EMA21| < 0.0005*price AND |price-VWAP| > 0.2*ATR(14). Enter opposite deviation direction: short if price > VWAP, long if price < VWAP. Exit: Initial stop at recent swing point (HH for shorts, LL for longs) from market structure; TP1 at 1R (risk = entry to stop); runner trailed by chandelier exit (10% off HWM). Regime filters: VIX > 16, skip FOMC days, avoid first 30 min after open.
